comparison: Paired monthly realized R at exit month including zero-trade months. Same exit algorithm, not forced same entry dates, holding periods or exits. Annual attribution also uses exit time.
decision: Historical incremental support requires base Lorentzian total R and PF greater than all three controls and each Bonferroni-adjusted primary interval lower bound above zero. Otherwise incremental value is unconfirmed. Secondary asset and stress profiles are descriptive only.
limitations: Previously inspected 2024-2026 sample; no pristine holdout or live claim
Signal variants also change opposite-signal exits
Different activity and exposure; report per-trade and per-calendar metrics
No margin or swap model; no orders; no parameter optimization
Bootstrap intervals conditional on chosen sample, variants and block length, not all historical research trials
